sections.title: Topics in Applied Mathematics
sections.description: In this class, we will discuss applied dynamical systems with an eye toward modern applications. After establishing some basic facts about differential equations, we will discuss hyperbolicity  of fixed points, stability of period orbits using Poincare sections, center manifold theory and some basic bifurcations. Time permitting, we will also cover different singular perturbative problems. In the latter part of the class, we will discuss optimal control and data assimilation.
